status: DESIGN ONLY; no extractor or learner implemented by this task
K_meaning: Full current simulator BuffId codebook capacity, not reachable-player-effect count. Unused/helper/enemy IDs can retain unused lookup rows.

N.meaning: Active normalized effect instances per state
N.batching: Pad to actual batch maximum with separate valid-row mask; N=0 produces zero pooled vector.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Signed BuffState/Game Amount. For Weak, TheBomb and ToricToughness this is already turns remaining.

fields.name: secondary_value
fields.meaning: Type-specific second value: Bomb damage, Inferno/CrimsonMantle self-damage, ToricToughness block, or duration-debuff round-start magnitude.

fields.name: progress_1
fields.meaning: Type-specific first progress value: cards left, draws left, Sloth/Tender plays, ChainsOfBinding applications this turn.

fields.name: progress_2
fields.meaning: Type-specific second progress value or flag: Bound card played; Panache armed/already-applied.

fields.name: skip_next_duration_tick
fields.meaning: Grace flag derived from public application history/current simulator duration bookkeeping; ID defines expiry boundary.

fields.name: has_source_relation
fields.meaning: Binary flag: a behavior-relevant public source relationship exists. Actual typed actor/card links are additional enemy/card observation data; this flag alone does not identify the source.

fields.name: application_order
fields.meaning: Zero-based rank among current logical PlayerBuffs rows after helper folding. An update to an existing stack keeps its position; this is not a lifetime application counter. Feed rank/max(N-1,1) to the model.

fields.name: has_secondary_value
fields.meaning: 1 if secondary_value applies to this effect; otherwise 0.

fields.name: has_progress_1
fields.meaning: 1 if progress_1 applies to this effect; otherwise 0.

fields.name: has_progress_2
fields.meaning: 1 if progress_2 applies to this effect; otherwise 0.

id_embedding.padding_row: No extra row required when using a dummy valid ID and an explicit padding mask.

coverage_checklist.status: Conservative source inventory from Claude; incomplete reachability proof; do not use as a certified minimum.

scaling.raw_records: Preserve original signed amounts, counters and links.
scaling.not_applicable: Zero value and zero has_* flag for optional columns 2-4.
scaling.missing_required: Extraction/coverage error; never silently impute zero.

relation_contract.scope: These are additional enemy/card observation data, not encoded by has_source_relation alone.
relation_contract.actor_identity: Use stable actor identities and explicit typed links; do not feed arbitrary actor IDs as scalar magnitudes. Do not reuse an identity for another actor.
relation_contract.Hex_Shrink: Link to the applying enemy, with current presence/alive state.
relation_contract.Dampen: Keep all active caster links and per-card saved upgrade levels.
relation_contract.ChainsOfBinding: Keep bound-card instance flags/links in the card block.

limitations: Ten columns are a defined first interface for checked scalar cases, not a proof that every effect in the 253-entry codebook is implemented or fully represented.
Source/caster links, bound-card links and saved per-card upgrades remain in enemy/card blocks; the per-effect tensor is not a complete restoration snapshot.
Codebook capacity and scalar-slot capacity do not replace per-ID adapters. Unknown/unmapped/missing required state must be reported, never silently set to zero.
Existing collector does not enforce the 214-card restriction.
Existing fork combines some game-instanced effects. Observed N follows fork state, not a universal game maximum. Retain full raw records for later fidelity corrections.
Presence masks are explicit interface choices and can be derived from per-ID adapters; they are not ten independent gameplay mechanisms.
Mean pooling plus count is lossy; the chosen 49-dimensional player block is not proved sufficient or minimal.
